rows.answer: Angina is chest pain or discomfort you feel when there is not enough blood flow to your heart muscle. It can feel like pressure or a squeezing pain in your chest, or like indigestion, and pain may also be felt in the shoulders, arms, neck, jaw, or back. It is a symptom of coronary artery disease, which happens when plaque builds up in the arteries and reduces blood flow. Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
rows.supporting_sentence: Angina is chest pain or discomfort you feel when there is not enough blood flow to your heart muscle.

rows.question: What is heart failure?

Heart failure is when your heart cannot pump blood properly. It does not mean your heart has stopped working or is about to stop working. There's no cure, but treatment and lifestyle changes can help.

There are lots of possible causes of heart failure. It can happen suddenly, such as after a heart attack or infection, or from long-term strain on your heart from high blood pressure or coronary heart

rows.answer: Heart failure means that your heart can't pump enough oxygen-rich blood to meet your body's needs. It doesn't mean that your heart has stopped or is about to stop beating, but without enough blood flow, your organs may not work well, which can lead to serious problems. Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
rows.supporting_sentence: Heart failure means that your heart can't pump enough oxygen-rich blood to meet your body's needs.
